[[File:Lostelle Adventures.png|150px|thumb|Lostelle in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] '''Lostelle''' (Japanese: '''マヨ''' ''Mayo'') is a little girl who lives on [[Three Island]]. Her father runs the [[Joyful Game Corner]] on {{OBP|Two Island|town}}, while her uncle runs the shop outside. She brings lunch to her father often. She likes to travel to the [[Berry Forest]] and pick [[Berry|Berries]]. ==In the games== Lostelle appears in {{game|FireRed and LeafGreen|s}} on the [[Sevii Islands]]. The {{player}} must rescue her from a wild {{p|Hypno}} and return her back to her father in order to progress with the plot. She will thank the player from rescuing her by giving them an [[Iapapa Berry]]. ===Quotes=== ;[[Berry Forest]] :''"Whimper... Sniff... Oh! Please, help! A scary {{ScPkmn}} appeared there a while ago. It kept scaring. It made Lostelle scared. I'm too scared to move! But I want to go home... Oh! Here it comes again! No! Go away! It's scaring me! Waaaaaaah! I want my daddy!"'' * After battling Hypno :''"Ohh! That was so scary! Thank you! Lostelle came here to pick some Berries. You can have [[Iapapa Berry|this]]!"'' :''"What's your name? Lostelle's scared, so can I go with you to my daddy's house? Okay! Let's go home!"'' ;[[Joyful Game Corner]] :''"It's okay, Daddy! I got to be friends with !"'' * If talked to again :''"Listen, listen! Please show me being cool again!"'' ;{{OBP|Three Island|town}} :''"Hi, ! You're always so cool! {{color2|000|Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen Versions|FireRed and LeafGreen}} |} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== In ''[[PS275|A Vicious Cycle of Possibilities]]'', Lostelle was in {{OBP|Three Island|town}}, looking for her {{p|Dunsparce}} who got lost. She found it in the middle of a road where the [[Kanto Pokémon Federation|Kanto Rider Federation]] was riding on their way to wreak havoc in [[Berry Forest]]. The group approached the little girl and began to frighten her but {{adv|Deoxys}} appeared and defeated the gang. Upon its leaving, {{adv|Giovanni}} walked over and indicated that he knew the Pokémon's identity. Lostelle later faxed drawings of Giovanni and Deoxys to {{adv|Bill}}, who warned {{adv|Red}} and {{adv|Blue}} of what was happening. ====Pokémon==== {| align="left" width="25%" |- | {{InactivePoké|Lostelle|Dunsparce|Lostelle Adventures.png|normal|link=no}} |} {{-}} ==Trivia== * Lostelle's encounter with a wild Hypno in the games may be a reference to Hypno's original [[Pokédex]] entry in Pokémon Red and Green, where it is said to have kidnapped a child once. ==Names== {| style="background: #{{Psychic color light}}; {{roundy|10px}}; border: 3px solid #{{Psychic color}}" |- style="text-align:center" !
